method: 只读 text/ 素读，未开 md

facts.fact: 抬头三处：2014-11-14 周五（Clare 43、Beck 38、Alba 13）出现两次，中间插 2006-08-10 周四（Alba 13、Henry 43、Clare 35）；即 Alba 13 岁这一年里同一天与八年前的那一夜。
facts.quote: Friday, November 14, 2014 (Clare is 43, Beck is 38, Alba is 13)

facts.fact: 婚事由来与手续：两人早就想结婚，去年六月伊利诺伊同性婚姻合法化时买了戒指；决定在家办；几周前从市政厅领到「self-uniting」结婚许可。
facts.quote: We bought rings last June, when Illinois made same-sex marriage legal. We decided to get married at home. We obtained a special “self-uniting” marriage license from City Hall weeks ago.

facts.fact: 宾客与缺席者逐字：Charisse、Gomez 及孩子 Max/Joe/Rosa；Celia；David 与 Nancy Kendrick 及 Nadia/Colin；Henry 的朋友 Ben；Beck 在 Meeting 的朋友。Kimy 95 岁、心脏衰竭仍坚持到场。Clare 的父亲体弱不能旅行；Beck 的父母不来，且「希望我是另一个人」，背地里念着 Jasper。
facts.quote: Kimy is feeling unwell but insisted on being here—at ninety-five, her heart is failing, alas. My father is too frail to travel, and Beck’s parents wish I was someone else entirely and aren’t here (they miss Jasper and ask after him wistfully when I’m not around

facts.fact: 仪式是贵格会式：无人主持，两人当众交换「promises」，到会朋友即为见证，由上帝结合。着装：Beck 梅子色紧身裙、淡妆、box braids 盘成髻；Clare 淡绿西装、头发披下；Henry 死后她开始掉发、剪到肩长，今早发现几乎长回原样。
facts.quote: Beck insisted that she wouldn’t really feel married by a secular ceremony, so we decided on the traditional Quaker ceremony.

facts.fact: Alba 的状态与座位：薰衣草色长袖裙、黑色乱发编成整齐法式辫；脸色很白、神情内向出神，让 Clare 怀疑她要病了或更糟；座位按事先约定在门边、Kimy 旁边；她也没吃早饭。
facts.quote: Alba is sitting near the door, next to Kimy, as we’d agreed. Alba looks pretty in her lavender dress with long sleeves, her unruly black hair French braided into neatness. She’s very pale—she has an inward, preoccupied expression

facts.fact: 誓言逐字（双方同一句式）：在上帝与这些朋友面前，我娶你为妻，愿以神力相助做你有爱有信的妻，至死方休。证书是 Beck 底特律的朋友做的，Prudence 朗读，宾客以见证人身份签名。Clare 回头找 Alba 签名，却找不到她。
facts.quote: “In the presence of God and these our friends, I take thee to be my wife, promising with divine assistance to be unto thee a loving and faithful wife so long as we both shall live.”

facts.fact: Alba 自述动机与动作：一上午头痛，怕自己在陌生宾客面前当场消失；等两人说完 intent、趁 Prudence 读证书时脱鞋溜出客厅，进房关门坐床上等，等一会儿就「不在了」。落点是 2006-08-10 父母卧室门口，她看他们睡着、想过悄悄走掉，却哭到停不下来把他们吵醒，说不出原因，父亲给她浴袍、两人轮流抱她摇她，父亲低声问「Is it that bad?」，她摇头但不说。
facts.quote: I don’t want to bother Mama, but I’ve had a headache all morning and I am worried that I might disappear during the wedding, in front of strangers.

facts.fact: 回来后：她重新出现在门口、头发散开，已哭过；两手往下轻按表示「一开口就会崩」。Clare 带她上楼（床上堆着行李箱，今晚飞巴黎度蜜月），问「Did you time travel?」她点头；问是否被吓到，摇头；不肯说内容；「I want you to be happy」；「I can’t keep all these secrets」；确认就是那晚哭着出现的那一夜。收尾 Beck 问怎么了，Clare 答「Grief, I think. It just catches us at weird times.」，两人互称 dear wife 亲吻，隔壁先静后鼓掌。
facts.quote: “Grief, I think. It just catches us at weird times.”

turning_point: 进了：第 7、8 条即本章转折——Alba 在母亲婚礼上消失，回到八年前父母卧室痛哭那夜，回来后只能承认「去过」，却把内容咽下（「I can’t keep all these secrets」）；秘密的性质与「想让你们幸福」并列，是本章的情感支点。
